import zipfile, re
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

NS = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main',
      'r': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'}

with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    print("FILES IN ARCHIVE:")
    for n in z.namelist():
        print(" ", n)
    print()

    # workbook.xml -> sheets
    wb = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
    print("SHEETS (workbook.xml):")
    for s in wb.find('m:sheets', NS):
        print(" ", s.attrib)
    print()

    # rels
    try:
        rels = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
        print("RELS:")
        for r in rels:
            print(" ", r.attrib)
    except KeyError:
        print("no workbook rels")

import zipfile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

M = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'

with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
    print("SHEET1 ROWS:")
    for row in root.iter(f'{{{M}}}row'):
        r = row.attrib.get('r', '?')
        cells = []
        for c in row.iter(f'{{{M}}}c'):
            ref = c.attrib.get('r', '?')
            t = c.attrib.get('t')
            s = c.attrib.get('s')
            v = c.find(f'{{{M}}}v')
            isel = c.find(f'{{{M}}}is')
            val = None
            if v is not None:
                val = v.text
            elif isel is not None:
                txts = [t.text for t in isel.iter(f'{{{M}}}t')]
                val = ''.join(txts) if txts else None
            cells.append(f"{ref}[t={t},s={s}]={val!r}")
        print(f"row {r}: " + " | ".join(cells))
    print()
    print("STYLES (numFmts + cellXfs):")
    styles = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/styles.xml'))
    nf = styles.find(f'{{{M}}}numFmts')
    if nf is not None:
        for f in nf:
            print("  numFmt:", f.attrib)
    xfs = styles.find(f'{{{M}}}cellXfs')
    if xfs is not None:
        for i, xf in enumerate(xfs):
            print(f"  xf[{i}]:", xf.attrib)

import zipfile
with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    print(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode('utf-8'))

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os, sys

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "budget.xlsx"
print("File:", path, "| Exists:", os.path.exists(path))
if not os.path.exists(path):
    print("ERROR: file not found in", os.getcwd())
    sys.exit(1)

# 1) Raw dump of every sheet (no header assumption)
all_sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None, header=None)
print("Sheets:", list(all_sheets.keys()))

grand_raw = 0.0
for name, df in all_sheets.items():
    print(f"\n===== Sheet '{name}' raw (rows={len(df)}, cols={len(df.columns)}) =====")
    print(df.to_string())
    num = df.select_dtypes(include=[np.number])
    if num.size:
        print("Numeric column sums (raw):", {str(c): float(v) for c, v in num.sum(axis=0).items()})
        t = float(num.to_numpy().sum())
        grand_raw += t
        print(f"Sheet numeric total (raw): {t}")
    else:
        print("No numeric cells.")
    total_mask = df.apply(
        lambda r: str(r.iloc[0]).strip().lower().startswith("total") if pd.notna(r.iloc[0]) else False,
        axis=1,
    )
    excl = df[~total_mask]
    n_excl = excl.select_dtypes(include=[np.number])
    if n_excl.size:
        print(f"Sum excluding rows whose first cell starts with 'total': {float(n_excl.to_numpy().sum())}")
    else:
        print("No numeric cells outside Total rows.")

print(f"\nGRAND TOTAL raw (all numeric cells, all sheets): {grand_raw}")

# 2) Header-based analysis
print("\n===== Header-based analysis =====")
for name in all_sheets:
    dfh = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=name)
    print(f"\n--- Sheet '{name}' with header row ---")
    print("Columns:", list(dfh.columns))
    print(dfh.to_string())
    num = dfh.select_dtypes(include=[np.number])
    if num.size:
        for c in num.columns:
            print(f"Column '{c}' sum: {float(num[c].sum())}")
